TrueAPNGSaveVideo.description: Export native ComfyUI VIDEO as animated APNG, with automatic FPS and looping. APNG does not contain audio.

fps_mode.name: FPS mode
fps_mode.tooltip: source uses the video frame rate; manual uses Manual FPS.

manual_fps.name: Manual FPS
manual_fps.tooltip: Used only in manual mode; changes playback speed without interpolation.

filename_prefix.name: Filename prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: Path relative to output; subfolders are allowed.

compress_level.name: Compression level
compress_level.tooltip: Lossless PNG compression: 0 is faster/larger; 9 is slower/smaller.

max_side.name: Maximum side
max_side.tooltip: 0 = original size. Otherwise limit the longest side, preserving aspect ratio without upscaling.

verify_file.name: Verify file
verify_file.tooltip: Check animation structure and decode every frame before publishing the file.

mask.name: Transparency mask
mask.tooltip: Optional ComfyUI mask: 1 = transparent, 0 = opaque. One mask or one per frame.

quality.name: Quality
quality.tooltip: 100 keeps the original pixels. Lower values reduce RGB precision; gradients may show banding. Alpha is preserved.

resize_method.name: Resize method
resize_method.tooltip: Downscaling filter. lanczos: existing sharp filter; lanczos_progressive: staged averaging then Lanczos; box: pixel averaging; bicubic/bilinear/hamming: alternatives; nearest: hard pixel edges. Used only when max_side reduces size.

optimize_frames.name: Optimize frames
optimize_frames.tooltip: Try changed rectangles and multiple lossless PNG compression strategies. At tolerance 0 all pixels stay exact. Extra encoding work may take longer.

preview.name: Preview
preview.tooltip: Show an animated APNG image preview, not a video player. Disable to hide the preview.

optimization_tolerance.name: Optimization tolerance
optimization_tolerance.tooltip: 0 = exact. 100 = RGB tolerance up to 100% per channel, only accepted with at least 1% smaller frame data. Alpha stays exact. Requires optimize_frames.

trim_start.name: Trim start
trim_start.tooltip: Remove this many frames from the start before resizing and optimization. Must leave at least two frames together with trim_end.

trim_end.name: Trim end
trim_end.tooltip: Remove this many frames from the end before resizing and optimization. Must leave at least two frames together with trim_start.
